title: Protocol to generate Gastruloids
author: Stefano D Vianello
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.9j5h4q6

steps.title: Wash Cells with PBS
steps.instruction: Aspirate the culture medium using a vacuum line and glass pasteur pipette and replace with 3 mL PBS-/- for a short wash.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the surface of the well remains glossy and cells are not completely dried out during liquid removal.

steps.title: Dissociate Cells with Accutase
steps.instruction: Aspirate the PBS and replace with 500 µL Accutase.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for approximately 3 minutes.
Tap the sides of the plate to facilitate dissociation until most cells are floating as clumps or single cells.

steps.title: Collect Cell Suspension
steps.instruction: Collect the dissociated cells into a clean 15mL Falcon tube labeled 'cells'.

substeps.instruction: Slightly tilt the plate and use a P1000 pipette to pipette the suspension up and down to break down clumps, using each ejection to wash the plate surface.
Wash the surface of the well again using ~4.5 mL DMEM-10% Serum, pipetting up and down to collect remaining cells, and transfer this secondary suspension to the same Falcon tube (total volume 5 mL).

steps.title: Centrifuge and Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Perform two sequential PBS-/- washes via centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the initial suspension at 200 x g (1000 rpm, 15.5 cm rotor radius) for 4 minutes at 4 °C.
Aspirate the supernatant without disturbing the pellet using a vacuum line and glass pasteur pipette.
Redissolve the pellet in 10 mL PBS-/-.
Centrifuge again at 200 x g (1000 rpm, 15.5 cm rotor radius) for 4 minutes at 4 °C.
Repeat the aspiration and PBS-/- wash step one more time.

steps.title: Resuspend Cells in N2B27
steps.instruction: Aspirate the final supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL N2B27.

substeps.instruction: Thoroughly resuspend the pellet to ensure a single cell suspension by pipetting several times (~20) using a P1000, then a P200, and finally a P20.

steps.title: Count and Prepare Cell Suspension
steps.instruction: Determine cell concentration and prepare a 5 mL N2B27 suspension containing 37,500 cells (7.5 cells/µL).

substeps.instruction: Load 10 µL of the N2B27-cell suspension into a manual cell counter (Neubauer chamber/haemocytometer) to calculate concentration.
Add the calculated volume of cell suspension containing 37,500 cells to 5 mL fresh N2B27.

steps.title: Seed Cells in 96-well Plate
steps.instruction: Dispense the cell suspension into an ultra-low-adhesion 96-well plate.

substeps.instruction: Load the 5 mL N2B27-cell suspension into a multichannel pipette reservoir.
Dispense 40 µL of the solution into each well.
Keep the reservoir well-mixed by pipetting up and down with the multichannel pipette and agitating the reservoir periodically.
Lightly tap the plate against the hood surface to ensure drops are at the bottom of each well.
Verify cell presence under a microscope.

steps.title: Incubation Day 1 and Day 2
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate undisturbed in a humidified incubator at 5% CO2.

substeps.instruction: Day 1 (t=0h-24h): Leave undisturbed for 24 hours.
Day 2 (t=24h-48h): No intervention needed; leave to grow for another 24 hours. Gastruloids should appear as ~100 µm clusters.

steps.title: CHIR99021 Treatment Day 3
steps.instruction: At t=48h-72h, treat gastruloids with CHIR99021.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 16 mL N2B27 containing CHIR99021 at a final concentration of 3 µM.
Dispense 150 µL of this solution into each well (total volume 190 µL per well).
Incubate for 24 hours. Gastruloids should reach ~200 µm diameter.
Remove 150 µL of medium from each well using a multichannel pipette.
Replace with 150 µL fresh N2B27.
Incubate for 24 hours. Gastruloids should reach ~300 µm diameter.
Remove 150 µL of medium from each well using a multichannel pipette.
Replace with 150 µL fresh N2B27.
Incubate for 24 hours. Gastruloids should become ovoid (~600 µm) and eventually look like a bowling pin (~700-800 µm).

steps.title: Extended Culture Day 6 and 7
steps.instruction: Optionally extend culture up to 168h (7 days total).

substeps.instruction: Option A: Continue daily medium changes in the 96-well plate (increased risk of adhesion/degeneration).
Option B: Transfer individual gastruloids to separate wells of a 24-well plate in 800 µL fresh N2B27, replace half the medium one day later, and maintain on an orbital shaker in the incubator.
